battle-stance.name: Battle Stance
battle-stance.desc: 一种均衡的战斗状态，使你的技能暴击率提高 3%，并使移动受损效果的持续时间缩短 10%。持续至取消。
battle-stance.en: A balanced combat state that increases the critical strike chance of your abilities by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%. Lasts until canceled.

defensive-stance.name: Defensive Stance
defensive-stance.desc: 一种防御性战斗状态，使你受到的所有伤害降低 15%，造成的所有伤害降低 10%。持续至取消。
defensive-stance.en: A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%. Lasts until canceled.

war-machine.name: War Machine
war-machine.desc: 你的自动攻击产生的怒气额外提高 10%。击杀敌人后立即获得 5 点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高 30%，持续 8 秒。
war-machine.en: Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage. Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

thunder-clap.name: Thunder Clap
thunder-clap.desc: 冲击 8 码内所有敌人，造成 3,346 点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低 20%，持续 10 秒。超过 5 个目标后伤害递减。对所有目标附加 Rend 效果。
thunder-clap.en: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 3,346 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Inflicts Rend on all targets.

impending-victory.name: Impending Victory
impending-victory.meta: 瞬发 · 近战范围 · 25 秒冷却
impending-victory.desc: 立即攻击目标，造成 2,555 点伤害，并恢复你 30% 的最大生命值。击杀可获得经验或荣誉的敌人后，重置 Impending Victory 的冷却并使其无需消耗怒气。
impending-victory.en: Instantly attack the target, causing 2,555 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health. Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.

heroic-leap.name: Heroic Leap
heroic-leap.meta: 瞬发 · 8-40 码范围 · 1.5 秒冷却
heroic-leap.desc: 腾空跃向目标地点，以破坏性力量砸落，对 8 码内所有敌人造成 1,021 点物理伤害。
heroic-leap.en: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 1,021 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

crackling-thunder.name: Crackling Thunder
crackling-thunder.desc: 雷霆一击的范围扩大 50%，且使受影响目标的移动速度额外降低 20%。
crackling-thunder.en: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.

storm-bolt.name: Storm Bolt
storm-bolt.meta: 瞬发 · 20 码范围 · 30 秒冷却
storm-bolt.desc: 将你的武器掷向敌人，造成 1,223 点物理伤害，并使其昏迷 4 秒。
storm-bolt.en: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 1,223 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.

rend.name: Rend
rend.desc: 挥舞武器猛击，对 10 码内所有目标造成 11,117 点物理伤害，并使其流血，在 20.0 秒内额外造成 14,258 点流血伤害。
rend.en: Lash out with your weapon, striking all targets within 10 yds for 11,117 Physical damage instantly and wounding them for an additional 14,258 Bleed damage over 20.0 sec.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.desc: 5 秒未受到伤害后，每 1 秒恢复 6% 生命值。生命值低于 35% 时，每 1 秒恢复 2% 生命值，且越接近死亡恢复量越高。
second-wind.en: Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec. Restores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.

frothing-berserker.name: Frothing Berserker
frothing-berserker.desc: 致死打击和 Cleave 有 20% 的概率立即返还所消耗怒气的 10%。
frothing-berserker.en: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.

bounding-stride.name: Bounding Stride
bounding-stride.desc: 英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短 15 秒，且英勇飞跃后移动速度提高 70%，持续 3 秒。
bounding-stride.en: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

pain-and-gain.name: Pain and Gain
pain-and-gain.desc: 每次受到伤害时，恢复 2.0% 的最大生命值。此效果每 10 秒最多触发一次。
pain-and-gain.en: When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. This can only occur once every 10 sec.

intervene.name: Intervene
intervene.meta: 瞬发 · 25 码范围 · 1.5 秒冷却
intervene.desc: 高速冲向一名友方目标，在其处于 10 码范围内时，拦截所有针对其的近战和远程攻击，持续 6 秒。
intervene.en: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc: 向前方锥形区域释放冲击波，对 16 码内所有敌人造成 881 点伤害并使其昏迷 2 秒。
shockwave.en: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 881 damage and stunning all enemies within 16 yards for 2 sec.

rallying-cry.name: Rallying Cry
rallying-cry.desc: 发出集结的怒吼，使 40 码内所有队伍或团队成员获得 12% 的临时及最大生命值，持续 13 秒。不在团队中时，获得的生命值额外提高 50%。
rallying-cry.en: Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 12% temporary and maximum health for 13 sec. Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.

field-dressing.name: Field Dressing
field-dressing.desc: 受到的治疗效果提高 3%，自我恢复效果额外提高 10%。
field-dressing.en: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

spell-reflection.name: Spell Reflection
spell-reflection.desc: 举起武器，反弹施放在你身上的第一个法术，并使你受到的魔法伤害降低 20%，持续 5 秒。
spell-reflection.en: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.

shattering-throw.name: Shattering Throw
shattering-throw.meta: 1.5 秒施法 · 25 码范围 · 3 分钟冷却
shattering-throw.desc: 将武器掷向敌人，移除任何魔法免疫效果，并造成 31,347 点物理伤害，无视护甲。对吸收护盾造成的伤害最多提高 500%。
shattering-throw.en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, removing any magical immunities and causing 31,347 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.

rumbling-earth.name: Rumbling Earth
rumbling-earth.desc: 震荡波的范围扩大 6 码，且命中至少 3 个目标时其冷却时间缩短 15 秒。
rumbling-earth.en: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

berserker-shout.name: Berserker Shout
berserker-shout.desc: 进入狂暴状态，移除并在 6 秒内免疫恐惧、昏迷和定身效果。同时移除 24 码内团队成员的恐惧效果，并使 5 秒内下一个控制效果的持续时间缩短 50%。
berserker-shout.en: Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec. Also remove fear effects from and reduce the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 24 yds.

intimidating-shout.name: Intimidating Shout
intimidating-shout.meta: 瞬发 · 8 码范围 · 1.5 分钟冷却
intimidating-shout.desc: 使目标敌人因恐惧而畏缩，同时使 8 码内所有敌人逃离你，且移动速度降低 70%，持续 9.6 秒。受到伤害可能解除效果。
intimidating-shout.en: Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 9.6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

honed-reflexes.name: Honed Reflexes
honed-reflexes.desc: 剑在人在、援护、Interpose、法术反射、风暴之锤和拳击的冷却时间缩短 10%。成功打断敌人施法后，对其造成的伤害提高 5%，持续 10 秒。
honed-reflexes.en: Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%. Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.

armored-to-the-teeth.name: Armored to the Teeth
armored-to-the-teeth.desc: 获得相当于你护甲值 20% 的力量属性。
armored-to-the-teeth.en: Gain Strength equal to 20% of your Armor.

double-time.name: Double Time
double-time.desc: 冲锋额外获得 1 次充能，且其冷却时间缩短 3 秒。
double-time.en: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

reinforced-plates.name: Reinforced Plates
reinforced-plates.en: Stamina increased by 20% and Armor increased by 20%.

barbaric-training.name: Barbaric Training
barbaric-training.desc: 猛击、旋风斩和 Cleave 造成的伤害提高 10%，暴击伤害提高 5%。
barbaric-training.en: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.

javelineer.name: Javelineer
javelineer.desc: 你的投掷技能范围扩大 5 码。勇士之矛、Shattering Throw 和 Wrecking Throw 造成的伤害提高 20%。Shattering Throw 和 Wrecking Throw 对非玩家目标造成 3 秒沉默效果。
javelineer.en: Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards. Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%. Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.

resonant-voice.name: Resonant Voice
resonant-voice.desc: 你的怒吼类技能效果持续时间延长 20%。
resonant-voice.en: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.

crushing-force.name: Crushing Force
crushing-force.desc: 致死打击造成的伤害额外提高 5%，暴击伤害提高 5%。
crushing-force.en: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.

cruel-strikes.name: Cruel Strikes
cruel-strikes.desc: 暴击率提高 4%，斩杀的暴击伤害提高 20%。
cruel-strikes.en: Critical strike chance increased by 4% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 20%.

two-handed-weapon-specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two-handed-weapon-specialization.desc: 装备双手武器时，你造成的伤害提高 12%，受到的范围伤害降低 8%。
two-handed-weapon-specialization.en: While wielding two-handed weapons your damage is increased by 12% and damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 8%.

wild-strikes.name: Wild Strikes
wild-strikes.desc: 急速提高 4%，自动攻击暴击时，自动攻击速度提高 40%，持续 10 秒。
wild-strikes.en: Haste increased by 4% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 40% for 10 sec.

anger-management.name: Anger Management
anger-management.desc: 每在攻击上消耗 20 点怒气，天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短 1 秒。
anger-management.en: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.

champion's-spear.name: Champion's Spear
champion's-spear.meta: 瞬发 · 25 码范围 · 1.5 分钟冷却
champion's-spear.desc: 将长矛掷向目标地点，将范围内所有敌人钉链于矛刺位置，立即造成 5,069 点物理伤害，并在 6 秒内额外造成 6,491 点物理伤害。长矛生效期间，再次激活此技能可使你跃向长矛处，对所有目标造成 1,019 点物理伤害。超过 5 个目标后伤害递减。产生 10 点怒气。
champion's-spear.en: Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 5,069 Physical damage instantly and an additional 6,491 Physical damage over 6 sec. While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 1,019 Physical damage to all targets. All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets. Generates 10 Rage.

stance-mastery.name: Stance Mastery
stance-mastery.desc: 你的姿态具有额外效果。Battle Stance：使你的技能暴击伤害提高 3%。防御姿态：当一次攻击造成的伤害达到你最大生命值的 20% 或以上时，该伤害降低 15%。
stance-mastery.en: Your stances have additional effects. Battle Stance Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%. Defensive Stance When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.

battlefield-commander.name: Battlefield Commander
battlefield-commander.desc: 你的怒吼类技能具有额外效果。Battle Shout：额外为你提供 3% 攻击强度。集结呐喊：额外提供 2% 生命值，持续时间延长 3 秒。刺耳怒吼：范围扩大 100%。Berserker Shout：范围扩大 100%。破胆怒吼：冷却时间缩短 15 秒。
battlefield-commander.en: Your Shout abilities have additional effects. Battle Shout: Grants you an additional 3% attack power. Rallying Cry: Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec. Piercing Howl: Radius increased by 100% Berserker Shout: Radius increased by 100%. Intimidating Shout: Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.

mortal-strike.name: Mortal Strike
mortal-strike.meta: 瞬发 · 近战范围 · 6 秒冷却
mortal-strike.desc: 发动凶猛一击，造成 34,474 点物理伤害，并使目标受到的治疗效果降低 50%，持续 10 秒。
mortal-strike.en: A vicious strike that deals 34,474 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.

overpower.name: Overpower
overpower.desc: 强力压制敌人，造成 20,967 点物理伤害。无法被格挡、闪避或招架。
overpower.en: Overpower the enemy, dealing 20,967 Physical damage. Cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

sudden-death.name: Sudden Death
sudden-death.desc: 你的攻击有概率使下一次斩杀无需消耗怒气、可对任意血量的目标使用，并以消耗 40 点怒气的效果计算伤害。
sudden-death.en: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.

fueled-by-violence.name: Fueled by Violence
fueled-by-violence.desc: Rend 和 Deep Wounds 造成的流血伤害的 85% 会转化为你的生命值。
fueled-by-violence.en: You are healed for 85% of the Bleed damage dealt by Rend and Deep Wounds.

die-by-the-sword.name: Die by the Sword
die-by-the-sword.desc: 招架率提高 100%，受到的所有伤害降低 30%，持续 8 秒。
die-by-the-sword.en: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

bloodsurge.name: Bloodsurge
bloodsurge.desc: Rend 造成的伤害有概率产生 5 点怒气。
bloodsurge.en: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.

improved-overpower.name: Improved Overpower
improved-overpower.desc: 压制获得 2 次充能，且伤害提高 15%。
improved-overpower.en: Overpower has 2 charges and deals 15% more damage.

improved-execute.name: Improved Execute
improved-execute.desc: 斩杀不再有冷却时间，若目标存活，消耗怒气的 10% 将被返还。
improved-execute.en: Execute no longer has a cooldown and if your foe survives, 10% of the Rage spent is refunded.

fervor-of-battle.name: Fervor of Battle
fervor-of-battle.desc: 若 Cleave 或旋风斩命中 3 个或以上目标，同时对主要目标施放猛击，该猛击额外造成 50% 伤害。
fervor-of-battle.en: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.desc: 每次使用有怒气消耗的攻击时，有 30% 的概率获得一次压制充能。即使该技能的怒气消耗已降至零，此效果依然有效。
tactician.en: You have a 30% chance to gain a charge of Overpower when you use an attack that has a Rage cost. This effect applies even if that ability's Rage cost has been reduced to zero.

colossus-smash.name: Colossus Smash
colossus-smash.desc: 击打地面，粉碎 10 码内所有敌人的护甲，造成 13,524 点物理伤害，并使你对其造成的伤害提高 35%，持续 10 秒。超过 8 个目标后伤害递减。
colossus-smash.en: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 13,524 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 35% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

impale.name: Impale
impale.desc: 你的技能暴击伤害提高 10%。
impale.en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10%.

efficiency.name: Efficiency
efficiency.en: Slam's Rage cost is reduced by 25%.

overpowering-finish.name: Overpowering Finish
overpowering-finish.desc: 压制对血量低于 35% 的目标额外造成 15% 的伤害。
overpowering-finish.en: Overpower deals 15% additional damage to targets below 35% health.

strength-of-arms.name: Strength of Arms
strength-of-arms.desc: 压制和猛击的伤害提高 20%，暴击伤害提高 20%。猛击和压制的暴击率提高 20%。
strength-of-arms.en: Overpower and Slam damage increased by 20% and critical strike damage increased by 20%. Critical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 20%.

broad-strokes.name: Broad Strokes
broad-strokes.desc: 巨人打击触发时为你附加横扫攻击效果。
broad-strokes.en: Colossus Smash grants you Sweeping Strikes.

sharpened-blades.name: Sharpened Blades
sharpened-blades.desc: 致死打击、Cleave 和斩杀的伤害提高 20%，暴击伤害提高 20%。
sharpened-blades.en: Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Execute damage increased by 20% and critical strike damage increased by 20%.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.meta: 瞬发 · 近战范围 · 4.5 秒冷却
cleave.desc: 对你正前方所有敌人造成 16,211 点物理伤害。超过 5 个目标后伤害递减。
cleave.en: Strikes all enemies in front of you for 16,211 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

powerful-momentum.name: Powerful Momentum
powerful-momentum.desc: 横扫攻击的次要目标额外承受 25% 伤害。
powerful-momentum.en: Secondary targets take an additional 25% damage from Sweeping Strikes.

martial-prowess.name: Martial Prowess
martial-prowess.desc: 压制和猛击使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高 5%，最多叠加 3 层。
martial-prowess.en: Overpower and Slam increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 5%, stacking up to 3 times.

dreadnaught.name: Dreadnaught
dreadnaught.desc: 压制引发地震波，对 10 码直线范围内所有敌人造成 3,833 点伤害。超过 5 个目标后伤害递减。
dreadnaught.en: Overpower causes a seismic wave, dealing 3,833 damage to all enemies in a 10 yd line. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

deep-wounds.name: Deep Wounds
deep-wounds.desc: 斩杀使目标染上 Deep Wounds。Deep Wounds 使目标在 8.0 秒内承受 3,765 点流血伤害。若效果再次触发，剩余伤害将叠入新一次 Deep Wounds 中。
deep-wounds.en: Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target. Deep Wounds Causes the target to suffer 3,765 Bleed damage over 8.0 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

tactical-edge.name: Tactical Edge
tactical-edge.desc: 巨人打击立即赋予 1 次 Sudden Death。
tactical-edge.en: Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death.

massacre.name: Massacre
massacre.desc: Condemn 可对生命值低于 35% 的目标使用。
massacre.en: Condemn is usable on targets below 35% health.

collateral-damage.name: Collateral Damage
collateral-damage.desc: 横扫攻击期间，技能命中第二个目标时，你下一次 Cleave 或旋风斩的伤害提高 25%，最多叠加 3 层。
collateral-damage.en: When an ability used during Sweeping Strikes damages a second target, your next Cleave or Whirlwind deals 25% increased damage, stacking up to 3 times.

bloodborne.name: Bloodborne
bloodborne.desc: 你的流血效果伤害提高 20%，暴击伤害额外提高 20%。
bloodborne.en: Your Bleed effects deal 20% increased damage and 20% increased critical strike damage.

bladestorm.name: Bladestorm
bladestorm.desc: 化身不可阻挡的毁灭风暴，在 5.3 秒内对附近所有敌人造成共 40,676 点物理伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害递减。你免疫移动受阻和失控效果，但可使用防御技能并可闪避攻击。
bladestorm.en: Become an unstoppable storm of destructive force, striking all nearby enemies for 40,676 Physical damage over 5.3 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects, but can use defensive abilities and can avoid attacks.

critical-thinking.name: Critical Thinking
critical-thinking.desc: 斩杀的暴击概率提高 20%，且立即额外返还所消耗怒气的 40%。
critical-thinking.en: Execute critical strike chance increased by 20% and Execute immediately refunds an additional 40% of the Rage spent.

master-tactician.name: Master Tactician
master-tactician.en: Tactician has a 5% increased chance to trigger.

bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
bloodletting.desc: Rend 和 Deep Wounds 的流血效果持续时间延长 33%，暴击概率提高 5%。若你已学习 Rend，致死打击会对生命值低于 35% 的目标施加 Rend。
bloodletting.en: Rend and Deep Wounds' Bleed effects last 33% longer and have a 5% increased critical strike chance. If you know Rend, Mortal Strike inflicts Rend on targets below 35% health.

executioner's-precision.name: Executioner's Precision
executioner's-precision.desc: 斩杀使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高 35%，最多叠加 2 层。
executioner's-precision.en: Execute increases the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 35%, stacking up to 2 times.

fatality.name: Fatality
fatality.desc: 致死打击有 50% 的概率对目标施加 Fatal Mark，最多叠加 5 层。你对持有 Fatal Mark 的目标使用下一次斩杀时，Fatal Mark 每层额外造成 11,858 点物理伤害。
fatality.en: Mortal Strike has a 50% chance to apply a Fatal Mark to your target, stacking up to 5 times. Your next Execute on a target with a Fatal Mark causes the Fatal Mark to deal 11,858 additional Physical damage per stack.

battlelord.name: Battlelord
battlelord.desc: 压制有 35% 的概率重置致死打击的冷却时间，并使下一次致死打击的怒气消耗降低 33%。
battlelord.en: Overpower has a 35% chance to reset the cooldown of Mortal Strike and reduce the cost of your next Mortal Strike by 33%.

mortal-wounds.name: Mortal Wounds
mortal-wounds.desc: 致死打击和猛击暴击时以 100% 效果施加 Deep Wounds。Deep Wounds 使目标在 8.0 秒内承受 9,231 点流血伤害。若效果再次触发，剩余伤害将叠入新一次 Deep Wounds 中。
mortal-wounds.en: Mortal Strike and Slam critical strikes inflict Deep Wounds at 100% effectiveness. Deep Wounds Causes the target to suffer 9,231 Bleed damage over 8.0 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.desc: 化身巨人，在 20 秒内使你造成的所有伤害提高 20%，并使你受到的范围攻击伤害降低 5%。
avatar.en: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.

master-of-warfare.name: Master of Warfare
master-of-warfare.desc: 第 1 级：你的单体近战技能有概率将猛击升级为 Heroic Strike。所有影响猛击的加成和天赋同样作用于 Heroic Strike。第 3 级：Master of Warfare 每层使致死打击、Cleave 和压制的伤害提高 10.0%，暴击伤害提高 10.0%。第 4 级：Heroic Strike 使你对下一次巨人打击波及目标造成的伤害额外提高 3.0%，最多叠加 5 层。
master-of-warfare.en: Rank 1: Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike. All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike. Rank 3: Each stack of Master of Warfare increases Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Overpower damage by 10.0% and critical strike damage by 10.0%. Rank 4: Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional 3.0%. Stacks up to 5 times.

slayer's-dominance.name: Slayer's Dominance
slayer's-dominance.desc: 你对主目标的攻击有 15% 的概率压破其防线并触发 Slayer's Strike，造成 14,896 点物理伤害，并为你叠加一层 Executioner，使你的斩杀伤害提高 3%，持续 18 秒。Executioner 可多层叠加。
slayer's-dominance.en: Your attacks against your primary target have a 15% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 14,896 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 18 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

imminent-demise.name: Imminent Demise
imminent-demise.desc: 每触发 3 次 Slayer's Strike，你获得一次 Sudden Death。使用 Sudden Death 会加速你的下一次剑刃风暴，额外多打 1 次（最多 3 次）。剑刃风暴的总持续时间不变。Sudden Death 有 100% 概率以 100% 效果触发 Reap the Storm。
imminent-demise.en: Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death. Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged. Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.

overwhelming-blades.name: Overwhelming Blades
overwhelming-blades.desc: 剑刃风暴的每次打击使所有命中的敌人获得 Overwhelmed，使你对其造成的伤害提高 1%，持续 20 秒，最多叠加 5 层。
overwhelming-blades.en: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.

vicious-agility.name: Vicious Agility
vicious-agility.desc: 英勇飞跃使冲锋的冷却缩短 5 秒，冲锋使英勇飞跃的冷却缩短 2 秒。
vicious-agility.en: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.

violent-euphoria.name: Violent Euphoria
violent-euphoria.desc: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗狂热状态，停止后 8 秒内获得 15% 急速。
violent-euphoria.en: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.

death-drive.name: Death Drive
death-drive.desc: Sudden Death 造成伤害的 15% 转化为对你的治疗。
death-drive.en: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.

culling-cyclone.name: Culling Cyclone
culling-cyclone.desc: 剑刃风暴的每次打击额外造成 20% 的伤害，平均分配至所有目标。
culling-cyclone.en: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: 当 Tactician 重置压制的冷却时间时，你下一次压制的伤害提高 20%，暴击伤害提高 20%，最多叠加 2 层。
opportunist.en: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

deadly-focus.name: Deadly Focus
deadly-focus.desc: Executioner 的持续时间延长 6 秒。
deadly-focus.en: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.

show-no-mercy.name: Show No Mercy
show-no-mercy.desc: Executioner 还使你的斩杀暴击概率和暴击伤害每层提高 1%。
show-no-mercy.en: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 1% per stack.

reap-the-storm.name: Reap the Storm
reap-the-storm.desc: 当 Cleave 命中 3 个或更多目标时，有 20% 概率掀起一阵钢铁乱舞，对附近所有敌人造成 13,692 点物理伤害并施加 Overwhelmed。超过 8 个目标后伤害递减。
reap-the-storm.en: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 13,692 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

slayer's-malice.name: Slayer's Malice
slayer's-malice.desc: 压制和斩杀的伤害提高 15%。
slayer's-malice.en: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.

unhinged.name: Unhinged
unhinged.desc: 剑刃风暴每 2 次打击后，自动对你的目标或附近随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成 100% 的正常伤害。
unhinged.en: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.

unrelenting-onslaught.name: Unrelenting Onslaught
unrelenting-onslaught.desc: 使用 Sudden Death 使剑刃风暴的冷却缩短 5 秒，并根据当前 Executioner 的层数，对主目标施加对应层数的 Overwhelmed。剑刃风暴期间可使用拳击和风暴之锤。剑刃风暴伤害提高 20%。
unrelenting-onslaught.en: Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have. You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming. Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

demolish.name: Demolish
demolish.meta: 引导 · 近战范围 · 45 秒冷却
demolish.desc: 对目标发动一系列精准有力的打击，对其造成 99,369 点伤害，并对 10 码范围内的敌人造成 52,609 点伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害递减。引导崩摧期间，你受到的伤害降低 10%，免疫昏迷、击退和强制移动效果。引导崩摧期间，你可以格挡、招架、闪避，并使用特定防御技能。
demolish.en: Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 99,369 damage to it, and 52,609 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects. You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

martial-expert.name: Martial Expert
martial-expert.desc: 你技能的暴击概率提高 10%，暴击格挡阻挡的伤害量提高 20%。
martial-expert.en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.

colossal-might.name: Colossal Might
colossal-might.desc: Colossal Might 使你下一次崩摧的伤害提高 5%，最多叠加 10 层。致死打击赋予一层 Colossal Might；Cleave 命中 3 个或更多目标时赋予一层 Colossal Might。
colossal-might.en: Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 10 times. Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.

boneshaker.name: Boneshaker
boneshaker.desc: 震荡波的昏迷持续时间延长 1 秒，昏迷结束后使受影响的敌人移动速度降低 40%，持续 3 秒。
boneshaker.en: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.

decimator.name: Decimator
decimator.desc: 崩摧的最后一击以 100% 效果对所有目标施加 Deep Wounds。
decimator.en: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.

arterial-bleed.name: Arterial Bleed
arterial-bleed.desc: Colossal Might 每层使你的 Rend 和 Deep Wounds 伤害提高 3%。
arterial-bleed.en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

tide-of-battle.name: Tide of Battle
tide-of-battle.desc: Colossal Might 每层使你的压制伤害提高 3%。
tide-of-battle.en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower by 3% per stack.

veteran-vitality.name: Veteran Vitality
veteran-vitality.desc: 当你的生命值降至 35% 以下时，获得 Second Wind，在 2 秒内恢复最大生命值的 12%。此效果每 60 秒最多触发一次。
veteran-vitality.en: When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

cut-to-the-bone.name: Cut to the Bone
cut-to-the-bone.desc: 致死打击暴击使你的 Rend 和 Deep Wounds 伤害提高 15%，持续 8 秒。
cut-to-the-bone.en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.

practiced-strikes.name: Practiced Strikes
practiced-strikes.desc: 致死打击和猛击的伤害提高 25%。Cleave 和旋风斩的伤害提高 15%。
practiced-strikes.en: Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%. Cleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.

precise-might.name: Precise Might
precise-might.desc: 致死打击暴击额外赋予一层 Colossal Might。
precise-might.en: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.

mountain-of-muscle-and-scars.name: Mountain of Muscle and Scars
mountain-of-muscle-and-scars.desc: 你造成的伤害提高 5%，受到的伤害降低 5%。体型增大 5%。
mountain-of-muscle-and-scars.en: You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage. Size increased by 5%.

celeritous-conclusion.name: Celeritous Conclusion
celeritous-conclusion.desc: 崩摧的最后一击赋予 10% 急速，持续 10 秒，并使你下一次致死打击的暴击概率提高 100%。
celeritous-conclusion.en: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.

dominance-of-the-colossus.name: Dominance of the Colossus
dominance-of-the-colossus.desc: Colossal Might 最多叠加 10 层。若你在满层时本应获得 Colossal Might，崩摧的冷却缩短 5 秒。崩摧命中的敌人，根据崩摧消耗的 Colossal Might 层数，在 10 秒内受你造成的伤害最多提高 10%，对你造成的伤害最多降低 10%。
dominance-of-the-colossus.en: Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times. If you would gain a stack of Colossal Might and are at max stacks, the cooldown of Demolish is reduced by 5 sec. Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 10% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

master-and-commander.name: Master and Commander
master-and-commander.desc: 集结呐喊的冷却时间缩短 120 秒。
master-and-commander.en: Cooldown of Rallying Cry reduced by 120 sec.

storm-of-destruction.name: Storm of Destruction
storm-of-destruction.desc: 剑刃风暴、Ravager 和崩摧现在会使所有命中目标的移动速度降低 60%，持续 6 秒，并使其受到的治疗量降低 50%，持续 10 秒。
storm-of-destruction.en: Bladestorm, Ravager, and Demolish now snare all targets you hit by 60% for 6 sec and decrease their healing taken by 50% for 10 sec.

sharpen-blade.name: Sharpen Blade
sharpen-blade.desc: 巨人打击使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高 15%，并使目标受到的治疗量降低 50%，持续 4 秒。
sharpen-blade.en: Colossus Smash causes your next Mortal Strike to deal 15% increased damage and reduce healing taken by 50% for 4 sec.

duel.name: Duel
duel.desc: 你向目标发起决斗。决斗期间，你和目标对彼此以外所有目标造成的伤害降低 50%。持续 12 秒。
duel.en: You challenge the target to a duel. While challenged, all damage you and the target deal to all targets other than each other is reduced by 50%. Lasts 12 sec.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.desc: 缴械敌人的武器和盾牌，持续 5 秒。被缴械的生物造成的伤害大幅降低。
disarm.en: Disarm the enemy's weapons and shield for 5 sec. Disarmed creatures deal significantly reduced damage.

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.desc: 使你的 Shattering Throw 或 Wrecking Throw 的冷却时间减少 50%，并使其对吸收护盾造成的伤害额外提高 250%。
demolition.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Shattering Throw or Wrecking Throw by 50% and increases its damage to absorb shields by an additional 250%.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.desc: 法术反射可反弹接下来施放在你身上的 2 个法术，被反弹的法术对施法者造成额外 100% 的伤害。法术反射的冷却时间增加 10 秒。
rebound.en: Spell Reflection reflects the next 2 incoming spells cast on you and reflected spells deal 100% extra damage to the attacker. Spell Reflection's cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.desc: 援护现在拥有 2 层充能，并在 5 秒内使目标盟友受到的伤害降低 20%。援护的冷却时间增加 10 秒。
safeguard.en: Intervene now has 2 charges and reduces the ally's damage taken by 20% for 5 sec. Intervene's cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

dragon-charge.name: Dragon Charge
dragon-charge.desc: 以高速在你前方一段距离内冲刺。路径上的所有敌人将承受 24 点物理伤害并被击退。
dragon-charge.en: Run at high speed at a distance in front of you. All enemies in your path will take 24 Physical damage and be knocked back.

berserker-roar.name: Berserker Roar
berserker-roar.desc: Berserker Shout 还使 12 码内的队友，在接下来 5 秒内受到的下一个控制效果持续时间降低 50%。
berserker-roar.en: Berserker Shout also reduces the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 12 yds.
